author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before was a squat pair of blocky halves with stub hooks and no top/bottom notches. Redrawn to the reference's round top view: four scalloped cubic lobes per hemisphere meeting at inward notches, V notches at the top and bottom of a full-height central fissure, one fold curling in from each side notch. Valid, gate pass.
omissions: Fifth lobe per side and the second fold per hemisphere (cannot keep 8 units at 48).
